import cv2
import numpy as np
import json
import math
from refine_all import pos_from_ground_contact

# Let's inspect objects in Frame 15:
# Frame 15: pose = (-0.25, 1.933, h=330)
# 1. Plant 1: pot bottom
img15 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0015.png')
# Pot is terracotta brown/orange:
# let's look at pot in frame 15 around u=145, v=350..450
pot_mask15 = (img15[:, :, 2] > 140) & (img15[:, :, 0] < 80) & (img15[:, :, 1] < 120)
ys_p1, xs_p1 = np.where(pot_mask15)
print(f"Plant 1 pot in 15: u in [{xs_p1.min()}, {xs_p1.max()}], v in [{ys_p1.min()}, {ys_p1.max()}], bottom v={ys_p1.max()}, center u={np.mean(xs_p1):.1f}")
print("Plant 1 ground contact from 15:", pos_from_ground_contact(15, np.mean(xs_p1), ys_p1.max()))

# 2. Chair 1 (back left chair) in Frame 15:
# Leg bottom pixels:
# Wood color:
chair_mask15 = (img15[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img15[:, :, 2] < 170) & (img15[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img15[:, :, 1] < 100) & (img15[:, :, 0] < 60)
# Chair 1 is around u in [220, 280]
chair1_mask15 = chair_mask15.copy()
chair1_mask15[:, 300:] = 0
chair1_mask15[:, :200] = 0
ys_c1, xs_c1 = np.where(chair1_mask15)
print(f"Chair 1 in 15: u in [{xs_c1.min()}, {xs_c1.max()}], v in [{ys_c1.min()}, {ys_c1.max()}], bottom v={ys_c1.max()}, center u={np.mean(xs_c1):.1f}")
print("Chair 1 ground contact from 15:", pos_from_ground_contact(15, np.mean(xs_c1), ys_c1.max()))

# 3. Table in Frame 15:
# Table is around u in [300, 420]
table_mask15 = chair_mask15.copy()
table_mask15[:, :300] = 0
table_mask15[:, 450:] = 0
ys_t, xs_t = np.where(table_mask15)
print(f"Table in 15: u in [{xs_t.min()}, {xs_t.max()}], v in [{ys_t.min()}, {ys_t.max()}], bottom v={ys_t.max()}, center u={np.mean(xs_t):.1f}")
print("Table ground contact from 15:", pos_from_ground_contact(15, np.mean(xs_t), ys_t.max()))

# 4. Plant 2 in Frame 16:
img16 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0016.png')
pot_mask16 = (img16[:, :, 2] > 140) & (img16[:, :, 0] < 80) & (img16[:, :, 1] < 120)
# plant 2 pot is for u < 50
pot2_mask16 = np.zeros_like(pot_mask16)
pot2_mask16[:, :50] = pot_mask16[:, :50]
ys_p2, xs_p2 = np.where(pot2_mask16)
print(f"Plant 2 pot in 16: u in [{xs_p2.min()}, {xs_p2.max()}], v in [{ys_p2.min()}, {ys_p2.max()}], bottom v={ys_p2.max()}, center u={np.mean(xs_p2):.1f}")
print("Plant 2 ground contact from 16:", pos_from_ground_contact(16, np.mean(xs_p2), ys_p2.max()))

# 5. Couch in Frame 14:
img14 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0014.png')
hsv14 = cv2.cvtColor(img14, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
couch_mask14 = cv2.inRange(hsv14, (100, 20, 50), (130, 150, 200))
ys_couch, xs_couch = np.where(couch_mask14)
print(f"Couch in 14: u in [{xs_couch.min()}, {xs_couch.max()}], v in [{ys_couch.min()}, {ys_couch.max()}], bottom v={ys_couch.max()}, center u={np.mean(xs_couch):.1f}")
print("Couch ground contact from 14:", pos_from_ground_contact(14, np.mean(xs_couch), ys_couch.max()))

# 6. Chair 2 in Frame 19:
img19 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0019.png')
# Chair 2 is around u in [400, 500]
chair2_mask19 = (img19[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img19[:, :, 2] < 170) & (img19[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img19[:, :, 1] < 100) & (img19[:, :, 0] < 60)
chair2_mask19[:, :350] = 0
ys_c2, xs_c2 = np.where(chair2_mask19)
print(f"Chair 2 in 19: u in [{xs_c2.min()}, {xs_c2.max()}], v in [{ys_c2.min()}, {ys_c2.max()}], bottom v={ys_c2.max()}, center u={np.mean(xs_c2):.1f}")
print("Chair 2 ground contact from 19:", pos_from_ground_contact(19, np.mean(xs_c2), ys_c2.max()))
